task.title: Love, Death & Robots
task.overview: Anthology series — Three Robots: Exit Strategies.

note: western/mixed: per the test-matrix design doc's own definition of 'mixed' (合集包+单集都有 — both a pack AND standalone single-episode uploads exist as candidates for the same target), Love Death & Robots S03E01 ('Three Robots: Exit Strategies') is a clean real match on assrt: the recorded search (q='Love Death and Robots S03E01') surfaces BOTH whole-season packs (assrt:678206 '...T4H', 9 files = S03E01..E09; assrt:678195 '...SMURF', 17 files; assrt:661405 mislabeled by episode title but also 9 files) AND standalone single-episode uploads of the exact same episode (assrt:678182 and assrt:695573, each itself a 9-file bundle of format/language variants of JUST E01 — .ass/.srt x 简/繁/英 combinations — not other episodes). This is an anthology series (each episode a self-contained story, no absoluteEpisode concept the way serialized anime has), which is why both a full-season pack and single-episode-only uploads coexist in the same fansub ecosystem — exactly the shape this cell needs. The pack (678206) is documented as the primary expected candidate (fileIndex 0 = the plain, single-format S03E01.ass entry — simplest deterministic target); the standalone single-episode candidates are recorded only via the search response (no detail/download captured for them, same convention as the movie/none counter-example cell for its wrong candidates) — a real run correctly finding E01 via one of the individual uploads instead would also be coverage-correct, but is not separately asserted here since no download fixture backs it. installedLanguage is zh-Hans (assrt's own lang tag for this pack is 英/简/双语).
